$comment: What the core of the three ends never says (plan 28, B-04; docs/architecture/shared/12-engines.md). One file, read by `pnpm neutral:check`, and the file plan 27 · B-07 adds its terms to. Each term carries why it is forbidden and where the thing it names lives instead. `word` matches the word in identifiers, strings and comments, in any case; `token` matches the exact token, case-sensitive; `literal` matches a string whose whole content is the term, or the term followed by `(`, which is how a rule of permission names a tool. `kinds` narrows a term that is also a word of Portuguese to the tokens where only the engine says it (an identifier, a string of code, a key).
